note: Regenerated defs drop the Signals-category products-enable tool after enablement moved to the core API; the core product-enablement-create tool is added but disabled.
Removes in-component per-index series summing; data prop is now the number source and series is visual-only, so callers pass aggregated data in.
Smoke script drops hand-rolled .env parser, calls load_dotenv and ensure_cloudflare_configured(Settings()) for api_base and key.
Renames tool identifier create_parser_recipe to create_ai_trace_parser; hook name useCustomParserMaxTool and other Max naming remain.
Router registration renamed from signal_grouping_pause to signal_processing with SignalProcessingViewSet; viewset restructured as a resource.
Moves ID-JAG helpers out of auth-errors into a new lib/id-jag.ts module and imports isIdJagAccessToken from there.
Extracts per-leaf loop into apply_tile_to_leaves returning a TileApplication struct; ordered commit/compose/produce/mark stays inline.
Changes Python score aggregation (fallback from label/score, neutral when no signal) and adds a labels constant; both SQL queries keep duplicated projection.
Adds shared lib/utils/parseMarkdownToTipTap used by both the paste handler extension and the markdown-table migration.
Replaces manual model_activity_signal dispatch in save with ModelActivityMixin on OAuthApplication; adds signal handler registration.
Drops the cdc_enabled check; always calls cleanup_cdc_resources_on_deletion on the source impl, postgres source decides itself.
Refactors research output into old/new artefact lists and fail-loud parsing; reviewers are still derived from findings, agent does not set them directly.
Removes local _has_legacy_metrics and reuses experiment_has_legacy_metrics from the experiments models module.
Replaces icontains run search with shared apply_trigram_search helper on branch/run_type, with exact SHA prefix and PR number; adds trgm migration.
Renames workflow class, inputs, workflow type string to reconcile-precalculated-data and env vars to RECONCILE_PRECALCULATED_DATA_*.
Extracts resolve_effective_team_id and adds parent_team_id param to for_team; the unscoped Manager attribute and its comment are unchanged.
Removes pull_request_target label-docs job from inkeep workflow and moves docs labeling into the existing auto-assign-labels title script.
Drops the eval-time check_ongoing_interval/upper-bound guard in MetricsExtractor, relying on the existing metrics alert config validation.
Extracts context-menu rendering into getGridItemContextMenu and keys loading by kind; no GridColumn component or keyboard-nav hook extracted.
Adds is_cloudflare_configured in cloudflare.py and model_registry's _cloudflare_configured delegates to it, dropping the getattr guards.
